description:
PoplePAC 1.2.0 is here!


We are thrilled to announce PoplePAC 1.2.0! This major release delivers full periodic boundary condition (PBC) solid-state modeling, ORCA 6.1.1 integration with custom basis selector widgets, modular sub-controller architecture refactoring, and user file overwrite protections.

🧊 Periodic Solid-State Builder & Crystal IO (230 Space Groups)
Full crystal structure manipulation supporting all 230 space groups via spglib, GaussView-style 0D–3D periodic boundary condition tutorials, Miller plane visualizations, translation vector placement, intercell boundary bonding, and a 100x vectorized void/porosity analyzer.

⚛️ ORCA 6.1.1 & Quantum Suite Upgrades
Comprehensive ORCA 6.1.1 input builder & validator with Stuttgart pseudopotential support and interactive basis set catalog filtering (`BasisSelectorWidget`). Plus INDO/CIS excited states absorption spectrum analysis and MOPAC SADDLE reaction path trajectory playback with video export.

🚀 Modular Sub-Controller Architecture
Refactored `main_window.py` into specialized sub-controllers (`dock_manager`, `file_io_operations`, `molecule_controller`, `quantum_dialogs`, `tool_controller`), maintaining 100% API compatibility and thread safety while improving maintainability.

🛡️ Read-Only Result Protection & VTK Camera Fixes
Automatic 'Save As' enforcement for calculation output files (.out, .orcout, .log, .aux, .cif) to prevent accidental loss of raw calculation logs. Fixed camera Near/Far clipping range issues during interactive VTK mouse zooming.
